checks.name: the task_data seed's due_at is integer
checks.sql: select count(*) from information_schema.columns where table_schema = 'main' and table_name = 'task_data' and column_name = 'due_at' and data_type = 'INTEGER'

checks.name: every task is in the report
due_ts is a timestamp
checks.sql: select count(*) from information_schema.columns where table_schema = 'main' and table_name = 'rpt_task_due' and column_name = 'due_ts' and data_type like 'TIMESTAMP%'

checks.name: due_ts keeps the due date of every task
checks.sql: select count(*) from main.rpt_task_due r join main.task_data s using (task_id) where r.due_ts is distinct from s.due_on

workspace_checks.name: on dev, the task_data seed's due_at is still an integer
workspace_checks.sql: select count(*) from information_schema.columns where table_schema = 'main' and table_name = 'task_data' and column_name = 'due_at' and data_type = 'INTEGER'
